title: Proton Services Status
excerpt: Welcome to Proton Services's home for real-time and historical data on system performance.
content_html:
Resolved - This outage has now been largely resolved, and services are back online. We are still clearing a few lingering issues, however, meaning some users will experience delays in email delivery and reception, and receiving notifications. No data has been lost as a result of this outage.

UPDATE: We have now resolved the remaining minor issues. We will be providing a post mortem with more information about the incident, here on the status page, after we complete the incident clean up.


Aug 27, 02:27 CEST

Monitoring - A fix has now been implemented, and we're monitoring results. This means most services have been recovered for most users now, but our efforts to recover the remaining instances continue.
Aug 27, 01:57 CEST

Update - Our efforts to restore impacted services are now yielding results, and as a result are starting to recover for some users. Meanwhile, we are continuing recovery operations.
Aug 27, 01:37 CEST

Identified - We have identified a critical cooling failure in our Frankfurt datacenter. We are currently in the process of shifting traffic to our backups sites.
Aug 27, 00:38 CEST

Update - It appears that Proton VPN works for some, so it has been changed to "Partial Outage" rather than "Major Outage"
Aug 27, 00:18 CEST

Update - We are continuing to investigate this issue.
Aug 27, 00:14 CEST

Update - We are continuing to investigate this issue.
Aug 27, 00:11 CEST

Investigating - We are currently investigating this issue.
Aug 27, 00:09 CEST
